I reviewed the redlines and added a few suggestions (see attached FinPay-DPA-redlines_v2.docx). High level:

- Transfer language: we keep the SCCs as the primary mechanism and add a short UK Addendum that references the UK IDTA approach. I added an explicit clause (Section 5.3) noting that if UK regulators require a different mechanism, parties will discuss in good faith and execute a limited addendum.

- Evidence: proposed appendix with a short exportable Transfer Impact Summary for your auditors.
